book.name: Irhuka
book.title: Isarhe iyiki Ize iyi Irhuka aka atsɛng

content: Isisok ra akpe
Ru unum inggbaashia ri inuma utɔɔva, ri igɔ̃kpeka, akatsɛrh ha anyanga abinkɛ umbɔ aka agbisha azĩmbɔ ru udzaka.
Umbɔ akpo utarh ukpuku utsim ru udzaka uku ugɔ̃rhũkpɔ.
Bɔr umbɔ aka atsĩ, umbɔ asi inyãmbɔ ukom Uteijee Uyesu.
Umbɔ ana awe ri idzeu ifɛrhɛ ha, kanying inera ivaa idɛ̃ɛ̃ ikhapa ru umbɔ, itsim atorho aka aterha ake arhang ru nyaki ishaa unum.
Akatsɛrh ha agũ iwei na asũrhã atsimbɔ ra abĩ, aner ha agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Awu use utsu umbi abee uner urhɛ ra abika akpukpe?
Unga ashia nggimi, unga aka asoka! Aka ayitu ubinkpi unga aka adɛyiwa umbi, unga aka awu nggu umbi ru Ugarhirhi.
Agɛ awu ufang umbɔ aka idzowe Ungwɛ̃-Ner ra abi arhim, umbɔ anyapuwe unga nu igãrhãmau ucucii, ru unum untaar unga awuri isoka ikɛi.>>
Mɔcɛ umbɔ ayitu irhɛmnga.
Ivangyɛ umbɔ aka apfuri ra anang udzaka abambɔ asɔme abɔrɔ udom hã (11), angwɛ̃ imesanga, nu irhɛ abɔɔ ifɛrha ha.
Awu umbɔ Umaryamu Umagadarha, nggu Uyowana, nu Umaryamu uyisa Uyaku, nu akatsɛrh abɔɔ aka awu nggu umbɔ, umbɔ asɔme abi itser Uyesu ifɛrha ha.
Bɔr umbɔ asi ibemumbɔ idzidzɛrhe akatsɛrh ha, ubinkutsu umbɔ anyanga arherhe ha awu isheri itsi.
Bɔr Ubitru asok atĩ azĩã ru udzaka, agba apfu, na anyã atorho ukpekũ, na abvui azĩã adzeidzeu ifɛrha ha iki iwe.
Nú utsĩndĩ Uimawu
Ru unum hã ikɛi inera ivaa abika adɔsu Uyesu aka azɛ̃rhã awuri izĩ ungwɛ̃rhũ uteu ukpɔɔ ugburh Uimawu. Iderkpɔ iyongge akirhomita usɔka nu unying uzĩ Urusharhima.
Umbɔ anu irherhe nggu adɔka ru ubɛn ubinkpi uku ukorhe.
Umbɔ aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ irherha arherhe ifɛrhɛ ha nggu adɔkambɔ, Uyesu nibikanga adzeka aba azɛ̃rhã nggu umbɔ.
Bɔr Uyesu asi ibeenga umbɔ ahwɛng ugɛ awu unga.
Unga arhusa umbɔ agɛ, <<Umbi azɛ̃rhã na ani irherhu use ikivarhambi?>> Umbɔ atsurha adɛ̃ɛ̃, unyɛ̃ɛ̃mbɔ ughɔrhe.
Unying itsoka igburh Ukirhiyoba, arhusa unga agɛ, <<Awu ungo ikiyikango uwu utsen ru Urusharhima ungo uku usi ihwɛngngo ifɛrha ha iki ikorhe umɔ inum iyɛrɛ?>>
Unga arhusa umbɔ agɛ, <<Ifɛrhu use?>> Umbɔ agɛ, <<Arherhu Uyesu uner Unazarat, uner uwuku usɔm Arherhu-Num, uner ijee ra arherhe nu ikikorhe ra asu Unum na anera kishoo.
Ikɛi ateiya abika adzowe idɛm-Num nu anggbaashi abɔɔ aka adzowe unga ra abi ijee Uroma, umbɔ atsuke unga ufai akpe, na anyapuwe unga nu igãrhãmau ucucii.
Bɔr umɛn ifosa ugɛ unga awuri ifai Uisrairha. Utoma rimi, ifɛrha ha iki ikorhe kishoo unum untaar nukpi.
Utoma rimi, akatsɛrhmɛn abɔɔ adzaa umɛn idzeu. Umbɔ azĩmbɔ ru udzaka ri igɔ̃ ukpea ukpirɛ,
bɔr umbɔ asi ikpombɔ ukom iyornga. Umbɔ asok aba agɔr umɛn ugɛ umbɔ anyãmbɔ irhi, ípfu itser-Num igɔr umbɔ igɛ awu nggu urhɛ.
Mɔcɛ abimɛn abɔɔ asok azĩmbɔ ru udzaka azĩ anyã rimi hã ru nyaka akatsɛrh ha aka arherhe, bɔr umbɔ asi inyãmbɔ unga.>>
Unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Umbi adzunu use umbi rimi, amɛnmbi adɔ̃rhũ use rimi, ri iwe ru imangmang abinkɛ kishoo abika asɔm Arherhu-Num aka arherhe!
Asi iwea ufang Ukiristo aka ihwa ayetnum ri ifɛrha ha na atsĩ ri ikpikpoinga?>>
Na atirhi ru imesu Umusa nu iyi abika asɔm Arherhu-Num kishoo, asɔme umbɔ arherhe akirakɛ aka awe ri itsinga ri itsɛng Arherhu-Num kishoo.
Umbɔ aka ayoku ungwɛ̃rhũ uteu ha umbɔ aka izĩ, unga akorhe ugɛɛ unga awuri itɔng.
Umbɔ angipa unga agɔr agɛ, <<Usei nggu umɛn, unuma aka amaanga.>> Nggee unga azĩ asesa nggu umbɔ.
Ivangyɛ unga aka asei igha ubingha nggu umbɔ, unga anyangu uborodi, atar uwɛɛ adzowe Unum, na atsɔka adzowe umbɔ.
Mɔcɛ asumbɔ ayanga, umbɔ ahwɛng unga ikɛi, nu unga agwira ri inyĩnyãmbɔ.
Umbɔ arhusa adɔkambɔ agɛ, <<Anggɔm asi itsu amɛnmɛn ayiruke ri ivangyɛ unga aka arherhe arherhe nggu umɛn ru utsĩndĩ na amesuwa umɛn itsɛng Arherhu-Num?>>
Kanying umbɔ asok azĩmbɔ Urusharhima, umbɔ azĩ akpo abɔrɔ udom hã (11) ananga unying na abirabɛ aka awu nggu umbɔ.
Anu igɔr agɛ, <<Awu idzidzɛrhe! Uteijee aka asoka, adzekanga ru Usiman!>>
Mɔcɛ umbɔ ikivarhambɔ adzowe isarhe ubinkpi uku ukorhe ru utsĩndĩ, ru nyaka umbɔ aka ahwɛng Uyesu ri itsɔku uborodi.
Uyesu adzeka ra angwɛ̃ imesanga
Ivangyɛ umbɔ aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ irherha arherhe ifɛrha ha, akpurha anyã Uyesu akapɛng adɛ̃ɛ̃ ra ateumbɔ, na agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Ididɔɔr iwe nggu umbi.>>
Bɔr umbɔ agbipa iwei ifɛr umbɔ, umbɔ akaifɛrhkɔ agɛ umbɔ anyã imãrhã.
Unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Awu use utsu umbi agũ iwei, awu use umbi anu icang ikɛi ra amɛnmbi?
Àka arhi abokmum, nu adakmum. Awu umum nibikami! Àka abanga umum agũ. Imãrhã ishingge ri ijuɛ nggu apfupfu ru nyaka umbi aka agũ ru umum.>>
Ivangyɛ unga aka arherhe rimi, unga adɛyiwe umbɔ aboknga nu adaknga.
Bɔr umbɔ ana acang ra amɛnmbɔ, ri itsi anggɔm nu idzeu akarhãrhã, unga arhusa umbɔ agɛ, <<Umbi awembi ru ubingha ri nggimi?>>
Umbɔ adzowe unga awushu ubɛrh uwuku uvum.
Unga ayɛi atãi ra asumbɔ.

Unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Arherhamum ha rakɛ, umum iki idɛyiwa umbi rimɔ̃ɔ̃ umum iki iwu nggu umbi. Ugɛ awu ufang abina kishoo aka itsuafɛr ri itsimum umbɔ aka atsɛng ri Íkpem Umusa, nu abvur abika asɔm Arherhu-Num, nu Ambom.>>
Mɔcɛ unga ayanguwe amɛnmbɔ umbɔ ahwɛng itsɛng Arherhu-Num.
Unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Itsɛng hã iyɛ iki itsɛng igɛ awu ufang Ukiristo aka ihwa ayetnum na asoka ra akpe ru unum untaar.
Ni igɛ idzidzipa nu itsũwe arhim awuri idzowe isarhangge ri itsoknga, ra abĩã kishoo, awuri itirhi ru Urusharhima.
Awu umbi awuri idekuwe anera ifɛrha iyɛrɛ.
Umum iwuri idenukũ ubinkpi Utɛmum aka abemuwa, bɔr aka adãrhã ru utepa utsɛku umbi aka iyɛi ijee iyiki idzeka afã.>>
Ififũ Uyesu ra afã
Ivangyɛ unga aka akũna umbɔ adzek azĩ akhapa ru Ubetani, unga abera aboka atsuke idorh ru umbɔ.
Unga aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ itsuke umbɔ idorh, umɔ unga abɔruka umbɔ, ashupa unga afũmbɔ ra afã.
Mɔcɛ umbɔ adzowe unga igɔng na apfuri azĩmbɔ Urusharhima nggu anggɔm akarhãrhã.
Ubɛn unuma ikɛi umbɔ akɔng ru ufɔm Iya-Num anu ikpoi Unum.
